hi._note: Bhardwaj et al. 2020 CONSTRAINT-2021. Column names vary by release; the train CSV uses 'Post' and 'Labels Set' (comma-joined dims). If multi-label, the loader treats any hostile dim as threat=1, 'non-hostile' as 0. Adjust text_col/label_col to match your file.

ar._note: OSACT offensive/hate shared task. Often shipped tab-separated as text<TAB>OFF/NOT_OFF<TAB>HS/NOT_HS; the loader auto-falls back to TSV and maps OFF/HS/VULGAR/VIOLENT to threat=1.
